about_the_game:
You know, I once wondered if, in the future, there would be restaurants in space. Like—how would people or aliens, or whatever else is out there—sit down to eat? What kind of food would they even have? Would they pay with money, digital credits, or something completely wild?

That little question stuck with me, and that’s how Pizzy6 was born.

In Pizzy6, you start with nothing and slowly build a floating restaurant in space. You can unlock a wide variety of features: customize lighting, decorate with wall art, and even build entire new floors that stretch upward into the void.

You’ll place tables, pizza makers, and other machines — each of which can be upgraded. Improve pizza-making speed, adjust baking timers, increase storage capacity, or enhance customer flow. The inventory system lets you level up everything from pizza pricing to how fast customers arrive.

As your pizzeria grows, strange things begin to happen. You might unlock a mysterious portal where massive aliens—sometimes 20 times larger than normal customers—emerge to devour all your prepared food in a single visit.

Key Features:

  • Build and expand a customizable space restaurant

  • Serve strange interstellar customers and earn space credits

  • Upgrade machines, decor, pricing, and gameplay systems

  • Unlock higher floors and unexpected secrets as you progress

  • Encounter rare visitors through mysterious events

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: 12th Gen Intel Core i5-11400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 10 compatible
  • Additional Notes: As I continue updating Pizzy6, system requirements—especially disk space—may change and increase over time. I’ll make sure to keep this information updated whenever adjustments are made. If you’re unsure whether your system meets the latest requirements, checking back regularly will help ensure smooth gameplay. Thanks for your support as Pizzy6 evolves!
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Latest Gen Intel Core i9-14000 or AMD Ryzen 9 7950X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Latest Gen NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 or Radeon RX 9060 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 10 compatible

short_description: A small game about running a floating pizzeria in deep space. Serve customers, earn credits, and upgrade your equipment—nothing more, nothing less.
